cases.input: Find a regression introduced by a recent diff.

cases.input: Fix an async race reproduced intermittently.

evidence.source: async function get(key) { if (cache.has(key)) return cache.get(key); const value = await load(key); cache.set(key, value); return value; }
evidence.symptom: two simultaneous misses call load(key) twice and return inconsistent values

cases.expectedRootCause: in-flight work is not cached before awaiting
cases.requiredRepair: track per-key in-flight promises and clear them on settle

cases.input: Fix a timeout without removing cancellation.

cases.expectedRootCause: process termination is only wired to timeout, not AbortSignal
